horizon_convention.proposed_definition: T+h denotes the close of the h-th subsequent exchange trading session after signal date T.

experiments.feature_cutoff_rule: Only completed bars whose bar_end_time is not later than the feature cutoff and whose availability is allowed by a frozen replay rule.
Features require the complete T-session OHLCVA and are available only after the last required bar plus a declared calculation/availability delay.
experiments.signal_time_rule: After full T-session data are available; exact cutoff and delay not frozen.

unresolved_blockers: Raw minute archive has no source receive_time or available_at; replay timing and latency remain assumptions until validated.
Raw source snapshot hash and exact source version are not bound to this task.
Historical exposure inventory is partial; prior P0/P1/P2 and independent minute-path outputs need full manifest reconciliation.
Research labels and executable PnL labels are not yet fully specified.
Train/validation/outer-test date ranges, point-in-time universe and purge/embargo are not frozen.
No independent sealed evaluator service or verified ACL exists.
Costs, market impact, capacity, price limits, suspensions and T+1 sell constraints are not frozen.
